Please provide (or confirm the operative version of) the requests, and we will complete each response with the production position and any specific objection and its grounds. We will also provide a privilege log identifying any documents actually withheld on privilege grounds; we will not represent that a log is attached until one has been prepared and included. Regards, Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 2. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant asserts an objection to a particular request only where stated in the response to that request below. edits.text: 3. REQUEST-BY-REQUEST RESPONSES. edits.name: Request-by-request responses

edits.text: 4. PRIVILEGE LOG. [State whether any responsive documents are being withheld on a claim of privilege or work-product protection. Attach the completed log before service. If no responsive documents are withheld on these grounds, state that expressly. Do not refer to an unattached log.]
edits.name: Privilege log

edits.text: 5. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement these responses as required by the applicable rules. This statement does not reserve a right to delay disclosure or to assert an objection not stated with the specificity required for the relevant request.
edits.name: Supplementation
